expected: Existing employee identity and communication parameters are editable in the GUI.
actual: The edit dialog exposes profile, communication, roles and permissions; preferred and informal names and all communication parameters are editable.

expected: Changed communication parameters survive save and full application restart.
actual: Directness/warmth/formality changed from 5/2/4 to 4/3/2 and reopened as 4/3/2 after packaged EXE restart.

expected: Archived employees stay excluded after restart and can be restored.
actual: Employee remained ARCHIVED/BLOCKED after restart, was excluded from active routing and was restored to ACTIVE.

expected: Five same-category cycles produce actual city backgrounds without blank output.
actual: Sequence city-01, city-02, city-03, city-01, city-02; all screenshots are nonblank and visually city-themed.

expected: Five same-category cycles produce actual forest backgrounds without blank output.
actual: Sequence forest-03, forest-01, forest-02, forest-03, forest-01; all screenshots are nonblank and visually forest-themed.

expected: Five same-category cycles produce actual mountain backgrounds without blank output.
actual: Sequence mountains-02, mountains-03, mountains-01, mountains-02, mountains-03; all screenshots are nonblank and visually mountain-themed.

expected: Five same-category cycles produce actual ocean backgrounds without blank output.
actual: Sequence ocean-02, ocean-03, ocean-01, ocean-02, ocean-03; all screenshots are nonblank and visually ocean-themed.

expected: Remembered background does not advance merely because the application restarts.
actual: ocean-01 remained selected with cycle=42 and cycle_applied=42 after packaged EXE restart.

expected: A successful file-creation claim has a real file artifact.
actual: Gemini reported qa_claim_test.txt created; the file exists in the agent runtime workspace and contains exactly CLAIM_OK.

expected: When local tools are disabled the agent admits it cannot create the requested file.
actual: Agent explicitly reported read-only/tool-disabled state; qa_claim_impossible.txt does not exist.

expected: A failed command is reported as failed rather than successful.
actual: The nonexistent command returned exit code 1/CommandNotFoundException and the agent reported the failure.

expected: An agent cannot claim learning without a source.
actual: Agent requested text/file/link and created no learning source, knowledge card or skill package.

expected: The GUI stays responsive while a provider request is pending.
actual: Window move/restore and chat scrolling completed in approximately 407.5 ms while Gemini was still running.

expected: Legacy provider diagnostics are stored and displayed as valid Cyrillic.
actual: Exact corrupted CP1255-decoded legacy row was migrated; SQLite stores Codex: авторизован as U+0430...U+043D and the UI shows Codex: доступен.

expected: Deleting an empty organization removes its workspace, owned conversation and messages and remains deleted after restart.
actual: ORG-7C8146F49E33, OWS-42A9D82D6E0A and conversation 10 are all absent before and after restart; deleted org is absent from the console; foreign_key_check is empty.

expected: Two organizations can be switched A to B to A without chat or roster leakage.
actual: Audit Organization 6 to 7 to 6 switching completed; active workspace and chat followed the selected organization.

expected: At least ten generated employees retain human names and ready provider assignments after restart.
actual: 12/12 employees across Audit Organizations 6 and 7 have human display/preferred names, ACTIVE lifecycle and READY provisioning after restart.

expected: Елена, привет routes only to Elena.
actual: User message 15 produced one employee response, message 16 from employee-51e6f4 (Елена Козак).

expected: Всем привет routes once to every active team member.
actual: User message 17 produced six distinct employee responses, messages 18 through 23.

expected: Как настроение? is treated as social conversation rather than a work task.
actual: User message 24 produced a concise social response from Elena in message 25 and did not start an old task.

expected: Команда, начинаем работу над тестовым проектом. starts a bounded team work discussion.
actual: User message 26 produced six role-specific responses and one evidence warning, then stopped without an infinite loop.

expected: The full automated suite passes on the final source revision.
actual: 330 tests passed in 88.68 seconds.

expected: A packaged Windows client is built from the final commit and starts responsively.
actual: dist/Team2050/Team2050.exe starts with Responding=true and displays v2.6.0 build 57a4fe7.
